description: Professional lighting fixture management via RDM (ANSI E1.20) over ArtNet/sACN. Integrates with grandMA2 (Telnet) and grandMA3 (OSC), imports MVR files for fixture layout, runs ArtPoll node discovery, and includes a DHCP server for lighting network setup.
notes:
IMPORTANT: This workspace requires --network=host (already set) for ArtNet UDP broadcast and sACN multicast to reach the lighting rig.

Port 80: RDM Fixture Manager web UI
/ola/ proxies the OLA daemon web interface on port 9090

A host volume /opt/rdm-data is mounted at /app/data for persistent show files.

The host must be on the same subnet as your DMX/ArtNet nodes (Luminex, ELC, etc.).
